source: None of these numbers changes the basic hierarchy lesson. A larger L2 can retain a larger working set. More ZXNAME0000XZ bandwidth raises one off-chip ceiling. More shared memory can enable larger tiles or deeper pipelines. But software still needs access patterns that can exploit those resources.
zh: 这些数字都不会改变基本的层次结构课程。较大的 L2 可以保留较大的工作集。更多的 ZXNAME0000XZ 带宽提高了片外上限。更多共享内存可以启用更大的图块或更深的管道。但软件仍然需要可以利用这些资源的访问模式。
